svg.aria-label: Three zones. Global memory holds A and B as 8 by 8 grids; the block needs rows 2 and 3 of A and columns 4 and 5 of B, and at the step shown a 2 by 2 tile of each is copied into shared memory. There each value is marked times 2: it is read by 2 threads. The block's 2 by 2 tile of C sits in rows 2 and 3, columns 4 and 5 of C.
svg.text: Copy a tile once, read it T times.
At step k0 = 2 the block copies 1 tile of A and 1 tile of B, 4 values each. Every
value in shared memory is then read by 2 threads (×2): by T threads for a T × T tile.
